predictions: Another pretty strong week last Wednesday, with a nice little 17-6 record for the night. And I guess that means I'm doing pretty well this season, since that's exactly the correct pick rate I've had for the entire season so far (85-30, 73.9% correct). If the One Armed Bandits (1-4 so far, and the only 4 C matches I've gotten wrong), Bangin The Wire (1-4), and The Rock Bottoms (1-3) weren't here, I would be owning you guys. Alas, those confusing buckets of mess ARE here, so I'll have to deal…

Match of the week: (C Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ Dysfunctional Outlaws. Stumble Out's biggest hurdle (at least until they see the Bandits again in week 11) comes right here against the uber-dangerous yet ever- unpredictable Outlaws. The Outlaws have the weapons to take out any C team when they get it all together, but somehow they seem to end up with a few too many almosts. Can't be almost here. Stumble Out, 15-9.

Matches #2 & #3: (E Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Village Idiots; Sharky's Machine @ Death Throw. Only two teams in E are above 0.500 after week 5, and there is a very real chance that they are going to put too much distance between themselves and the pack for this to be anything but a two-team race. Here's the next chance to push that reality forward, as both Death Throw and the Idiots face one of those three 0.500 teams. Given how narrowly they each won just last week, that would be a pretty amazing reality. This division story becomes much better if both of the leaders fall, and that's exactly what we're going to go with! Ton 80 falls 13-11 because they can't win DCkt(?): and DT goes down, 14-10.

Match #4: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Show Me Your Tips. Alright, with Darty and Raging having only one loss between them, this battle of 3-2 squads is bordering on an elimination match in the B race. Despite their combined 2-4 record over the last three weeks, these teams actually have enough weapons to make a real run… IF they win here. Show Me, 14-10.

Match #5: (F Div.) Bangin The Wire @ Runs with Corks. The Corks are winning close match after close match, but the key word there is 'winning.' They already hold a two-match lead on the pack, and they get a chance to knock one of the chase trio back another here. Cork, 14-10.

Match #6: (C Div.) Rif Raf @ Off Constantly-Reboot. Here is the last pairing of the season guaranteed to produce a first-time winner. A lot of attendance issues have led to many of the losses here, so it's tough to know what to expect. We'll go with Rif Raf, in an odd 11-9.

Match #7: (G Div.) Nein Mark @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. Nein is trying to finish their run to a week 7 gunfight, but they had better not look past this opponent that has averaged almost 14 so far. They'll get it, but it won't be any type of walkover. Nein Mark, 15-9.

Match #8: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Rippin Darts. Rippin finally went and remembered how to win, just in time for this shot at their old close rivals from last fall in G division. This one looks to be pretty even, but Sofa has a lot to play for here. Let's go with Sofa, 14-10.

Match #9: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Nine Lives. The top three C teams are a combined 11-2. The bottom three are a combined 0-9. And in the middle are these two 2-2 teams. Which makes a run at the leaders, and which tries to avoid the cellar duo? Sanchez, 13-11.

Match #10: (A Div.) Liver Alliance @ Why So Serious? Is this the chance for Serious to take a swipe at moving up into the league's top four overall spots? Maybe, but it feels like Liver just has too much power and depth to be overtaken here. Liver Alliance, 17-7.

Match #11: (F Div.) Dart Side of the Moon @ Shark Shooters. If the Corkers stumble a couple times, and of the five-pack of 3-2 and 2-3 teams could control their own title fate. Both teams are coming off narrow losses; it looks like it will be Dart Side rebounding, 14-10.
Match #12: (B Div.) Trippin Bulls @ Iceman's. Is this Trippin's best shot at hitting that win column? Depends in part on whether Iceman's is going to play shorthanded again. Iceman's gets it, 14-10.
